aiTexts: This ultra-slim 14.1-inch laptop features a Full HD 1920x1080 IPS display with a 90 Hz refresh rate for clear visuals.
Powered by Intel Core i7-7500U or i9-8950HK processors with 12GB or 16GB RAM and SSD options up to 2TB, it delivers high performance for multitasking and creative work.
Equipped with Windows 11 Pro and integrated graphics, it supports professional software and seamless office-to-entertainment use.
The lightweight aluminum alloy body weighing 1.25-1.3kg offers durability and elegant portability.
Rich connectivity includes mini HDMI, USB 2.0, USB 3.0, miniSD, headphone jack, and DC 3.5mm interfaces.
Dolby audio system provides immersive sound quality for music and movies.
Ideal for business professionals, creatives, and users needing powerful, portable computing with versatile ports.
Comes with a 3-year international manufacturer warranty for reliable usage.

2304415502.detail_text: Discover true go-anywhere productivity Bring maximum mobility to your organization with the highly compact yet powerful Latitude E6230™ laptop. Agile performance Unleash your productivity with a range of performance options, including solid-state drives, cutting-edge Intel® Core™ processors, HD graphics and optional Intel® Rapid Start Technology™. Versatile usage Work comfortably with easy docking and the help of design features intended to make your time in front of the screen as productive as possible, anywhere you work. Effective collaboration With a high-performance antenna and the latest wireless and mobile broadband1 connectivity options, including LTE mobile broadband2, you don’t have to be inside an office to be at work. Business-class control Help protect your data and help your IT administrators stay in control. Through various available hardware and software components, Latitude is easy to manage and maintain over the course of its long life cycle In accord with current standards, the built-in 12.5-inch HD screen is lighted by LEDs and comes with an anti-glare finish. It offers a resolution of 1366x768 pixels and thus an aspect ratio of 16:9. Dell does not offer alternatives, but considering the screen diagonal, this is a balanced choice. Considering the 12.5-inch size, this resolution is not perceived as being too fine; it still offers a much better desktop overview than lower resolutions one would often find in cheaper and less efficient small devices (netbooks).

Description

Report this item or seller

Welcome

The warranty period of our products is three years.

All products are brand new, produced and sold directly from the factory, with good quality, low price and guaranteed after-sales service.

If there are any questions. Feel free to contact us. Enjoy your shopping!

Characteristic

[Full-size keyboard]: The full-size keyboard improves the convenience of input, and the independent numeric keypad makes input faster and more convenient.

[I9 Intel Processor]: Intel i9-8950HK dual-core CPU, low-power high-performance, powerful Windows 11 operating system, easy multitasking, smooth

[Large memory]: 16GB DDR dual-channel memory greatly improves the system response speed. Run multiple applications smoothly with 128/256/512/1TB/2TB SSDs at solid state speeds.

[Full HD screen]: The 15.6-inch 1920 × 1080 full HD IPS display allows you to enjoy more screen space, ultra-thin and ultra-wide screen.

[Battery and connectors] Multiple connectors to meet your different needs: 2 USB 3.0, Mini HDMI, audio, memory card, 1 charging connector. The notebook is also equipped with a large battery of 7.6 V/4000MWh, which is very convenient when traveling.

[Warranty] The product will be delivered within 2-5 business days. After purchase, the product is guaranteed for 3 years and lifelong customer service. If you have any questions about this product, please feel free to contact us.

[Other] Support Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, multiple applications, books, Wallpapers, calendars, calculators, clocks, etc.

[System language] Global version. You can change the language in the settings.

Package includes:

Laptop * 1

User Manual * 1

Power adapter * 1

Metal body with TPU+plastic materials offers durability; Windows 11 Pro enhances security and usability.
